The production file renders beautifully — wisps rising above the bowl, warm lamp glow, atmospheric vignette. The work is complete.

**Created `/app/index.html`** — a self-contained, atmospheric hero scene with a single steaming vegan ramen bowl as the sole visual focus:

**Scene (drawn with code, zero assets)**
- SVG bowl: charcoal ceramic body with gradient shading, glossy rim highlight, amber chicken-free miso-style soup, visible noodles (wavy strands with drop shadows), chili-oil swirls, bok choy, shiitake mushrooms, corn, scallion rings, sesame seeds, ripple rings on the soup, plus chopsticks resting on a ceramic rest draped over the rim
- Warm lamp glow from above (flickering), warm table pool, breathing halo under the bowl, soft shadow, and a dark vignette

**Motion (all respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`)**
- Canvas-based steam: ~40 elongated, drifting wisps rising from the soup surface, repelling from the pointer
- Floating dust motes, noodle-free soup pulsing, ripple rings expanding on the surface, rim-light flicker, subtle bowl bobbing

**Interactivity**
- A warm light follows the cursor (lerped, gentle flicker/scale, brightens near the bowl); bowl tilts subtly toward the pointer with 3D perspective; swiping across the bowl surges the soup ripples; when idle for ~2.6s the light slowly auto-drifts in a lissajous path so the scene stays alive on touch/no-mouse devices

**Details**
- Responsive (tested 1440×900, 420×820, 390×780), caps DPR at 2, pauses rendering when the tab is hidden, static wisps/no-light fallback under reduced-motion, `aria-hidden` on decorative layers with an accessible SVG label on the scene, no external requests at all

Verified via headless Chromium screenshots across desktop/mobile/reduced-motion (plus a canvas-content snapshot since some headless builds don't composite the live canvas) — no console errors.
